steps.expected_result: sensor-01 is enrolled and can authenticate with its issued identity
The valid signature is accepted and applied version becomes 1

steps.action: Record event event-01 from sensor-01 with sequence 1
steps.expected_result: The event is accepted with its sensor_id, event_id, sequence, observed_at, kind and bounded metadata

steps.action: Disconnect the sensor from the collector
steps.expected_result: The sensor reports the collector unavailable and retains queued event bytes locally

steps.action: Queue event event-02 with sequence 2 while offline
steps.expected_result: The event remains in the bounded sensor spool; overflow is reported as explicit loss

steps.action: Reconnect and deliver event-02, then repeat its acknowledgement
steps.expected_result: The collector records event-02 once and the repeated acknowledgement does not duplicate it

steps.action: Triage the accepted events and inspect the retention checkpoint
steps.expected_result: Events remain attributable to sensor-01 and any retention gap is explicit

steps.action: Restart the local services and restore the last accepted local state
steps.expected_result: Applied version, accepted event identities and explicit loss/gap accounting match the pre-restart state

expected_invariants: Signed desired state and monotonic apply
Replay-safe bounded spool with explicit loss accounting

negative_cases.action: Enroll again using an already consumed token
negative_cases.expected_failure: Enrollment is rejected and no second sensor identity is created

negative_cases.action: Send an event with an invalid certificate
negative_cases.expected_failure: Authentication is rejected before event acceptance

negative_cases.action: Queue events beyond the configured spool bound while offline
negative_cases.expected_failure: Additional events are not silently accepted; loss is reported explicitly

negative_cases.action: Attempt decoy access to the Internet and operational internal network
negative_cases.expected_failure: Network access is denied by default and no egress succeeds
